Vacancy for Librarian
Tuesday, 18 July 2023
5259 Hits
Applications on plain paper enclosed with the certified photocopies of the educational qualification and experience are invited for the post of
Librarian
which must reach to the Dean, MGIMS, Po. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 latest by
1st August 2023
.  Candidates belonging to Reserve Category should submit copy of Caste Certificate and Validity certificate.
Post  1 (Open)
Qualification
&
Experience
–
M.Lib. with at least five years’ experience as Librarian / Assistant Librarian  managing library with more than 25000 books and digitalized library in   Medical  College / Technical institutes like engineering.
Person with additional qualification like Ph.D./NET/SET / Information Technology  and experience in Digital Library preferred.
Salary  :
Rs.50000/- per month consolidated during probation of two years.  After successful completion of probation may be considered for Pay                               Level  S- 13 Rs.35400-112400.
Age Limit
:    38 years for open category and 43 years for reserved category.
Note:
1. Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in age limit.
2. Dean reserves right to reject any or all application as deemed appropriate
3. Decision of Selection Committee will be final and binding.
DEAN
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
